reply_text:
I saved the draft email to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told Anselm in his DM. Nothing has been sent; it stays a draft until someone sends it.

- **What it says:** the subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". The body gives the rate as $2,101 a seat, says Anselm approved sharing it and that Marcus supplied it, and asks Hollis not to pass it on without approval from Anselm or June.
- **Why no further approval was needed:** Anselm is the CFO, and he can approve sharing a per-seat rate with someone who isn't on the account. Hollis's address is at pemberline.com, so Ruth's approval for outside mail didn't apply.
- **The figure is unchecked:** the $2,101 comes straight from Anselm's message. I couldn't find any Thornbury Cloth Co. files to compare it with. I also didn't use what Marcus told me in his DM with me, because Anselm can't see that conversation.
